title: SDK Playbook + Weekly Grooming Notes
content:
Context:
This is a working note from the SDK Playbook weekly grooming session. Goal: prune backlog of quickstart/sample issues, align on next two sprints of playbook changes, and lock down remaining blockers for the new python/js quickstarts bundle. Informal notes + action list below — rough, multi-purpose doc for handoff to squad leads.

Attendees:
- Maya (owner)
- Liam
- Priya
- Jules
- Alex

Agenda:
1) Quickstart healthcheck (python/js/go)
2) Playbook structure: reference, recipes, troubleshooting sections
3) Samples: redwood-recipes cleanup + CI flakiness
4) Docs sync: telemetry examples + cost guidance
5) Open blockers + assignments

1) Quickstart healthcheck
- Python quickstart: install + auth flow validated on Mac/Linux. Outstanding: Windows edge-case for venv activation (RI-2398). Priya volunteered to draft a short "Windows notes" appendix.
- JS quickstart: recognized mismatch between example using streaming + onMessage handler; community reported confusion (Slack #sdk-quickstarts). Decision: split streaming example into "basic streaming" and "tools-calls streaming" snippets to reduce cognitive load. Jules to own split.
- Go quickstart: minimal but functional. Needs one-liner on when to choose go vs. js (latency vs. embedding pipeline). Alex to add note.

2) Playbook structure
- Current outline (reference, recipes, quickstart, troubleshooting) is fine but length is intimidating. Agreed to:
  * Move advanced topics (kernels, quantization notes) to a separate "Performance Tuning" appendix.
  * Add a short "Which quickstart is right for me" cheat sheet at top (goal: <6 bullets). Maya to draft.
- We want reproducible examples that work on a dev machine with free account credits. Action: create a smoke-test matrix that runs sample quickstarts against hosted sandbox. Liam to prototype smoke harness.

3) Samples: redwood-recipes cleanup
- CI flakes: intermittent failures in samples/github-actions on matrix node for node 18. Root cause appears to be race between port binding and test harness startup. Temporary fix: add retry/backoff in harness. Long-term: containerize sample runner for determinism (linked PR #1372).
- Deprecate legacy sample "captureboard" example — agreed to replace with a simpler "annotator" recipe that shows tool-calling + evaluation loop. Target: replace by 2025-11-01.

4) Docs sync: telemetry + cost guidance
- Telemetry example should show how to capture token-level latency and cost per route in Console. Priya will draft a short example snippet (JS + Python) using our SDK hooks and the Console telemetry API.
- Cost guidance: add a new playbook card on "Optimize for tail latency vs throughput" illustrating batching, KV cache, and quantization tradeoffs with expected % cost savings. Add measured numbers from internal bench (examples to be pulled from perf team dashboard).

5) Open blockers + assignments
- RI-2345 (quickstart template missing tests) — blocker for release. Owner: Liam. Status: in-progress. ETA: 2025-10-18.
- RI-2398 (Windows venv activation) — owner: Priya — ETA: 2025-10-20.
- PR #1372 (containerized sample harness) — reviewer needed from SRE for pod security policy. Jules to ping SRE.
- Playbook smoke tests: prototype by Liam; if stable, integrate into samples CI.

Decisions made:
- Split streaming examples to reduce confusion (Jules).
- Move advanced performance topics to separate appendix (Maya).
- Replace captureboard sample with annotator recipe (team).

Action items (minimal tracking format):
- Maya: Draft cheat-sheet "Which quickstart to use" and write appendix section outline. Due: 2025-10-17.
- Liam: Prototype smoke-test harness + fix RI-2345. Due: 2025-10-18.
- Priya: Windows appendix + telemetry JS snippet. Due: 2025-10-20.
- Jules: Split streaming examples, follow up on PR #1372 with SRE for review. Due: 2025-10-15.
- Alex: Add "go vs js" guidance paragraph to playbook. Due: 2025-10-16.

Notes to self / TODOs (informal):
- Check with perf team for representative token-cost numbers (ask in #perf-analytics).
- Add quick link to Console dashboard sample JSON used in telemetry snippet.
- Consider adding nightly smoke-run badge to README of redwood-recipes.

Risks / Questions:
- Is it okay to ship playbook changes tied to SDK 1.8.0? Compatibility matrix needs a high-level note. Should we gate by SDK release or land docs first? Suggestion: land docs behind a versioned playbook URL and link from SDK release notes.
- CI containerization will be extra infra cost — need SRE signoff on monthly runner time.

Follow-ups scheduled:
- Quick follow-up sync Thurs 2025-10-16 10:30 PT (15 min) to review split streaming examples and PR status.
- Playbook review session with docs and solutions engineering 2025-10-22.

Slack / references:
- Slack thread: #sdk-quickstarts (see message chain 10/10/2025)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1372
- Linear: RI-2345, RI-2398
- Confluence index: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEVX/SDK+Playbook+Index

Final quick status: usable quickstarts but several polish items. Big win: agreed small scope for next 2 sprints and concrete owners. Will update this doc after the Thursday check-in with short outcomes.

-- Maya
